description: This is a Java source file defining the final class 'Datasource' which models the <datasource> element in an entity configuration XML. It contains attributes and methods for parsing and accessing datasource configuration details in the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: SqlLoadPath
classes.description: Represents the <sql-load-path> child XML element associated with a datasource.

classes.name: ReadData
classes.description: Represents the <read-data> child XML element for datasource configuration.

classes.name: InlineJdbc
classes.description: Encapsulates the <inline-jdbc> element details for the datasource.

classes.name: JndiJdbc
classes.description: Encapsulates the <jndi-jdbc> element details for the datasource.

classes.name: TyrexDataSource
classes.description: Encapsulates the <tyrex-dataSource> element details for the datasource.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the value of the 'name' attribute of the datasource.

methods.name: getHelperClass
methods.description: Returns the helper class name used for the datasource.

methods.name: getFieldTypeName
methods.description: Returns the field type name associated with the datasource.

methods.name: getUseSchemas
methods.description: Indicates whether schemas are used.

methods.name: getSchemaName
methods.description: Returns the schema name specified.

methods.name: getCheckOnStart
methods.description: Indicates whether the datasource is checked on startup.

methods.name: getAddMissingOnStart
methods.description: Indicates whether missing entities are added on startup.

methods.name: getUsePkConstraintNames
methods.description: Indicates whether primary key constraint names are used.

methods.name: getCheckPksOnStart
methods.description: Indicates whether primary keys are checked on startup.

methods.name: getConstraintNameClipLength
methods.description: Returns the length for constraint name clipping.

methods.name: getUseProxyCursor
methods.description: Indicates whether proxy cursor is used.

methods.name: getProxyCursorName
methods.description: Returns the proxy cursor name.

methods.name: getResultFetchSize
methods.description: Returns the size of result fetch.

methods.name: getUseForeignKeys
methods.description: Indicates whether foreign keys are used.

methods.name: getUseForeignKeyIndices
methods.description: Indicates whether foreign key indices are used.

methods.name: getCheckFksOnStart
methods.description: Indicates whether foreign keys are checked on startup.

methods.name: getCheckFkIndicesOnStart
methods.description: Indicates whether foreign key indices are checked on startup.

methods.name: getFkStyle
methods.description: Returns the style of foreign key handling.

methods.name: getUseFkInitiallyDeferred
methods.description: Indicates if foreign keys are initially deferred.

methods.name: getUseIndices
methods.description: Indicates whether indices are used.

methods.name: getUseIndicesUnique
methods.description: Indicates whether unique indices are used.

methods.name: getCheckIndicesOnStart
methods.description: Indicates whether indices are checked on startup.

methods.name: getJoinStyle
methods.description: Returns the join style.

methods.name: getAliasViewColumns
methods.description: Indicates whether view columns are aliased.

methods.name: getAlwaysUseConstraintKeyword
methods.description: Indicates whether to always use constraint keywords.

methods.name: getDropFkUseForeignKeyKeyword
methods.description: Indicates whether to drop FK using foreign key keywords.

methods.name: getUseBinaryTypeForBlob
methods.description: Indicates whether binary type is used for BLOBs.

methods.name: getUseOrderByNulls
methods.description: Indicates whether NULLs are ordered explicitly in ORDER BY.

methods.name: getOffsetStyle
methods.description: Returns the offset style.

methods.name: getTableType
methods.description: Returns the table type.

methods.name: getCharacterSet
methods.description: Returns the character set.

methods.name: getCollate
methods.description: Returns the collation setting.

methods.name: getMaxWorkerPoolSize
methods.description: Returns the maximum worker pool size.

methods.name: getSqlLoadPathList
methods.description: Returns the list of SQL load paths.

methods.name: getReadDataList
methods.description: Returns the list of ReadData elements.

methods.name: getInlineJdbc
methods.description: Returns the InlineJdbc configuration.

methods.name: getJndiJdbc
methods.description: Returns the JndiJdbc configuration.

methods.name: getTyrexDataSource
methods.description: Returns the TyrexDataSource configuration.
